goal.question: Which weekday contributed the largest absolute order-count change? Identify its direction.

sql:
WITH items AS (
      SELECT order_id, product_id, seller_id, price, freight_value, p.product_category_name_english AS category,
             seller_state FROM order_items JOIN products_with_category_translation p USING(product_id)
      JOIN sellers USING(seller_id) 
    ), cohort AS (
      SELECT *, CASE WHEN ts >= '2018-05-01' AND ts < '2018-06-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS period FROM (SELECT o.order_id, order_purchase_timestamp AS ts, order_status, customer_state,
             (order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date)::INT AS late
             
             FROM orders o JOIN customers USING(customer_id) ) AS source WHERE (ts >= '2018-04-01' AND ts < '2018-05-01') OR (ts >= '2018-05-01' AND ts < '2018-06-01')
    ) SELECT period, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM cohort GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
